BiblicalUsage: Ardon is named once, as a son of Caleb by Azubah his wife, beside Jesher and Shobab in the genealogy of Judah. His name sits in the line that runs from Judah toward David.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name in the line of Judah is a name in the line of the promise, even when the story gives us nothing more.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
